parameters.jsCode: const allowed=new Set(["fabricated date","fabricated quote/action","fictional fixture envelope required","fictional owner/source required","invalid model fields","three-attempt recovery failed","unauthorized before retrieval","unsupported command"]);const e=$input.first().json;const ex=e.execution||{};const er=ex.error||{};const wf=e.workflow&&typeof e.workflow.name==='string'?e.workflow.name:'unknown workflow';const node=ex.lastNodeExecuted||(er.node&&er.node.name)||'unknown node';const raw=typeof er.message==='string'?er.message:'';const http=/^[1-5]\d\d$/.test(String(er.httpCode??''))?String(er.httpCode):(raw.match(/status code ([1-5]\d\d)\b/)||[])[1];const message=allowed.has(raw)?raw:http?'HTTP '+http:"unlisted error (text withheld)";return [{json:{workflow:String(wf).slice(0,120),node:String(node).slice(0,120),message,execution_id:String(ex.id??'').slice(0,40),execution_url:typeof ex.url==='string'&&/^https?:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.-]{1,100}(:\d{1,5})?\/workflow\/[A-Za-z0-9]{1,40}\/executions\/\d{1,20}$/.test(ex.url)?ex.url:''}}];

parameters.content:
## TendReview21
**Purpose:** Error workflow for fictional workflows 01-09.

**Inputs:** n8n Error Trigger (production runs only; publish 21 after import).

**Outputs:** POST /api/failure-log on the fixture API.

**Privacy:** Keeps workflow and node names, the execution ID, and a literal guard message or HTTP status; any other error text is withheld. No item data.
